mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS shows month-over-month growth exceeding 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates economic growth and corporate profit expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic expansion across manufacturing and construction sectors, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST show month-over-month growth exceeding 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months) signals aggressive policy that may trigger economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is rising (3mo > 0.5%) during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth expansion (GDPC1) indicates robust aggregate demand and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations adjust to stronger growth fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2000 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and residential investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate market sentiment effects.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 2000 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer spending and housing market activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST show month-over-month growth exceeding 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal market overheating and potential policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as growth expectations reverse.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising (MoM > 0.5%) during a late-cycle expansion.
